text:
ada (eng-security): Quick sync for the external assessment handoff. Need to lock the evidence path and confirm retest criteria before vendor kickoff.
leo (eng-sre): ack. what's the plan for KMS access? ephemeral sessions via kms-proxy like last time?
ada (eng-security): yes. kms-proxy to mint assessor sessions limited to Decrypt for the envelope key only. sessions expire after 6 hours. logs must be signed and forwarded to the evidence bucket.
nora (platform): I'll wire the proxy. question: do assessors require ReEncrypt for wrap/unwrap testing?
ada (eng-security): no. only Decrypt and DescribeKey. keep the surface minimal.
jin (security-ops): audit hooks: we need (a) envelope-wrap events, (b) ephemeral session creation, (c) KMS Decrypt trace with caller identity. All bound to the audit-export pipeline with immutable retention.
ada (eng-security): retention 180 days for vendor evidence. evidence-bot, can you create a read-only folder and presigned upload policy? :pray:
evidence-bot: created folder s3://redwood-evidence/external/assessment-1765089999/ at 1765089302 with presigned policy exp 48h
leo (eng-sre): putting a short example for the vendor to upload logs and proof artifacts:
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/envelope-log.json "s3://redwood-evidence/external/assessment-1765089999/envelope-log.json" \ 
  --acl bucket-owner-full-control \ 
  --server-side-encryption aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1234:key/abcd
```
ada (eng-security): Nice. For the retest matrix: each finding must include: fix PR link, deployment target (staging/prod), observability evidence (audit log entry id), and tester validation steps. Retest will be 'closed' when vendor verifies fix and we provide signed log slice.
leo (eng-sre): about signed log slice 14 how do we sign? we can attach the KMS signing envelope. Example payload: sha256(log-slice) + kms:Sign with key id audit-signing-key.
ada (eng-security): exactly. Add the KMS-Sign step to the evidence checklist.
jin (security-ops): scheduling: dry-run evidence collection Tue 10am PT, vendor kickoff Thu 2pm PT, retest window Mon following week. Oncall (leo) will be present for dry-run and kickoff.
nora (platform): small exception: if someone needs an emergency RBAC change during freeze, file exception ticket "sec-exception" and @ada will review. Keep changes scoped and time-limited.
ada (eng-security): yep. Also no observability schema changes after freeze cut-off (today 9pm PT).
leo (eng-sre): note: I'll seed the remediation tracker with initial tickets and a test-case column. linking tracker here once ready.
evidence-bot: remediation-tracker ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-PT-4321 at 1765090108
ada (eng-security): last thing 12 please make sure all deployed fix candidates include an instrumentation test that emits a unique trace id so we can find precise audit entries during retest. Example header: X-Vendor-Retest-Trace: PT-1765089999-<ticket>
leo (eng-sre): will add middleware to forward that header to logs for staging.
ada (eng-security): great. I'll DM exceptions and post the final vendor handoff doc after dry-run. :white_check_mark:
